term: exhaustiveness of the proposed empirical barrier
definition: BarrierExplainsAll says every empirically unprovable target in scope has ObservationBarrier. This is OPEN. AdditionalRelevantBarrier supplies an unprovable scoped target without that barrier and opposes that coverage, not the restricted-unprovability claim.
note: Analyst formulation; attribution deferred. Source STMT-WORLD-BEGINNING-NOT-DEMONSTRABLE and Hume verdict meanings remain separate. See docs/notes/scoped-empirical-proof-barrier.md.
